reference_inspection: Reference prefixes of all eight members already read before a scoring policy; explicitly exploratory, reference-inspected evaluation. Complete selected reference has not yet been parsed.
confirmed_provenance: Author dataset page calls this a LiDAR ground truth trajectory; paper VI-A describes batch tag/IMU camera trajectory estimation, PTP host synchronization and calibrated LiDAR-camera transform.
unresolved_provenance: No located primary document explicitly specifies the archive column convention, transform direction/body axes, or numerical clock/extrinsic mapping. A TUM-like file alone is not proof of these properties.

conditional_interpretation.columns: Unix timestamp seconds, tx ty tz metres, qx qy qz qw; following TUM syntax by explicit assumption, not a claim of an author-declared format.
conditional_interpretation.pose: Assume reference-world-from-LiDAR; archive-specific body-axis/extrinsic convention remains unverified. All pose errors are conditional on this assumption.
conditional_interpretation.time: Exact decimal seconds converted to int64 nanoseconds without floating Unix seconds; fixed zero offset from estimate scan-end point time. No offset search or nearest-only association.
conditional_interpretation.scale_and_extrinsic: One fixed unit scale and identity estimate/reference body transform, both declared rather than fitted. No GT-driven clock, scale, axis or extrinsic selection.

cohort: All 185 saved estimates in chronological order, original scan indices 1..185. No new state estimation or parameter tuning. Process only literal gt/flatwall_01.txt regular archive member; leave the other seven reference trajectories unopened.

validation.quaternion_policy: Reject outside tolerance; normalize within tolerance and report maximum original norm discrepancy.
validation.timestamps: strictly increasing int64; reject nonintegral nanoseconds, duplicates, unsorted or nonfinite rows

association.orientation: shortest-arc SO3 SLERP; exact timestamp uses exact row
association.coverage: One row per original estimate, reason and bracket indices/span. Out-of-range or long-gap rows excluded from numerical metrics but never hidden. No edge may bridge an excluded scan.

alignment.primary: One global least-squares proper rotation and translation fit on every paired position; unit scale, no reflection, no subsequence selection.
alignment.rank_policy: If either centered position matrix or cross covariance has rank < 2, omit global rigid-fit metrics and expose the degeneracy. Always report singular values and initial-pose-aligned diagnostics.
alignment.secondary: One full SE3 transform from the first paired pose; no further fit.

metrics: position APE after global rigid position fit when identifiable
position and SO3-angle APE after first-pose alignment
consecutive original-scan SE3 RPE translation norm and rotation angle; report every retained edge and elapsed time
reference and estimate path length on retained consecutive original edges
independent_checks: Frozen installed evo TUM parsing and no-scale Umeyama/APE/RPE on the exact declared paired cohort; independently implement Decimal timestamp bracketing and local interpolation. TUM and evo validate arithmetic only, not missing dataset provenance.
reporting: Publish all coverage, declared assumptions, exposure boundary, failures and numerical metrics. Do not compare to published GLIM ATEs with different association/alignment, claim a blind evaluation, physical calibration, improvement, GPU speed or algorithm adoption.
controller_freeze: Freeze evaluator, oracle and installed dependency source identities after analytic unit controls pass and before the first full selected reference read. New paths for any correction; preserve all prior protocols/receipts verbatim.
